## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
ROTATION. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.68% | 1M: +4.65%) and XLF ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.78% | 1M: +9.15%) alongside VXX falling (1W: -6.81% | 1M: -19.92%) and HYG/LQD signaling credit stress ↓ support a rotation into cyclicals with tech participation.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Credit stress EASING: HYG ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.25% | 1M: +0.60%) and LQD RECOVERY (1W: +0.20% | 1M: -0.16%) with Credit Spread flat (0.7285) CORRECTION. Reflation bid: CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.67% | 1M: +14.85%) and GLD ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.56% | 1M: +9.65%) ↑ rising.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral-to-looser: UUP BELOW TREND (1W: -0.32% | 1M: -1.48%) ↓ falling and TLT BELOW TREND (1W: -0.16% | 1M: -2.04%) while SPY/TLT is ↑ rising and ABOVE TREND, keeping equity-friendly liquidity.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Cyclicals and materials leading: DBB ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.92% | 1M: +9.47%) and XAR ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.75% | 1M: +8.30%); Financials XLF ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.78% | 1M: +9.15%) and Tech XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.68% | 1M: +4.65%) both participating. Defensives XLU BELOW TREND (1W: -0.18% | 1M: -2.94%) showing relative weakness—style: cyclical tilt with growth participation.

5. US vs Global?
US leadership intact: SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.35% | 1M: +2.57%) while EM via EEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.01% | 1M: +3.22%) is outperforming China where FXI is in RECOVERY (1W: +1.88% | 1M: -0.62%). Europe/Japan mixed; Europe roughly neutral vs US per regional ratios.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Speculative measures soft but not absent: IWM ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.09% | 1M: +2.91%) and ARKK ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.28% | 1M: +3.10%) are up, while the Speculation Index is ↓ falling and BELOW TREND (1W: -2.14% | 1M: -0.29%).

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Precious metals and industrial commodities strong: SLV ABOVE TREND (1W: +19.89% | 1M: +52.39%), PPLT ABOVE TREND (1W: +25.55% | 1M: +55.74%), GLD ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.56% | 1M: +9.65%), and CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.67% | 1M: +14.85%)— reflation/real-asset bid.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy mixed: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.01% | 1M: +0.61%) while BNO is in RECOVERY (1W: +1.85% | 1M: -1.51%) and UNG RECOVERY (1W: +6.48% | 1M: -7.38%), signalling selective strength but not broad energy breakout.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
Confirmed: VXX ↓ falling (1W: -6.81% | 1M: -19.92%) and HYG/LQD showing easing credit stress support a risk-on rotation narrative alongside SPY/QQQ ABOVE TREND. DIVERGENCE: LQD and several defensives show RECOVERY/CORRECTION patterns (minor divergence) — monitor traction into new year.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor cyclicals/materials and financial exposure via XLF, DBB and industrial/semiconductor ETFs while reducing exposure to utilities XLU and watching discretionary XLY in CORRECTION (1W: -0.90% | 1M: +4.84%). Bonds neutral-to-avoided as TLT BELOW TREND (1W: -0.16% | 1M: -2.04%).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: Materials/Industrials — DBB ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.92% | 1M: +9.47%), XAR ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.75% | 1M: +8.30%). BEARISH: Utilities — XLU BELOW TREND (1W: -0.18% | 1M: -2.94%), Consumer Discretionary XLY in CORRECTION (1W: -0.04% | 1M: +4.79%).

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: Silver SLV ABOVE TREND (1W: +19.89% | 1M: +52.39%) and Copper CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.67% | 1M: +14.85%). BEARISH: Oil/Brent remains RECOVERY — BNO RECOVERY (1W: +1.85% | 1M: -1.51%) until momentum confirms.

13. Key Levels?
VXX 20 (complacency threshold), HYG/LQD ~0.7285 (credit health), XLK/XLF 2.63 (growth vs value pivot).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

ROTATION. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive, with cyclicals/materials and financials showing strength while VXX and credit signals point to easing stress. Key risk: watch RECOVERY/RECOVERY signals in bonds and select defensives (LQD, XLU) for signs the rotation broadens or stalls.
